title: Richmond, KY — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Richmond, KY: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Richmond is a city in KY with a population of 35,000. Home of Eastern Kentucky University with access to Berea and the Daniel Boone National Forest. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.1.
